name: raw-jpg-stacker
title: RAW + JPEG stacker
description: Groups RAW files with their camera JPEG/HEIC (same file name, same capture time) into a single stack
author: maxxer

templates.name: stack-raw-jpg
templates.title: Stack RAW + JPEG
templates.description: Show RAW and JPEG/HEIC files from the same shot as one photo, with the JPEG as cover. Paste an API key in the step settings before enabling.

methods.name: stackRawJpg
methods.title: Stack RAW + JPEG
methods.description: Find the RAW or JPEG/HEIC sibling of this photo (same file name, same capture time) and stack them

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Your Immich API key with the asset.read, asset.update and stack.create permissions (Account settings → API keys)

primary.title: Stack cover
primary.description: Which file is shown in the timeline; the other stays inside the stack

maxTimeDifferenceSeconds.title: Max time difference (seconds)
maxTimeDifferenceSeconds.description: Capture times must be at most this far apart. 0 disables the check (match on file name only)

matchCamera.title: Require same camera
matchCamera.description: Only stack files whose camera make and model match (ignored when either file has no camera info)

rawExtensions.title: RAW extensions
rawExtensions.description: Comma-separated list of RAW file extensions

companionExtensions.title: JPEG/HEIC extensions
companionExtensions.description: Comma-separated list of processed-image extensions to pair with RAW files (earlier = preferred cover)

serverUrl.title: Immich server URL
serverUrl.description: How the plugin reaches the Immich API from inside the server container. Leave as http://localhost:2283 unless you run a separate microservices container
